sources.entry: Domain Generator - Free AI domain generator with availability check and price comparison

summary.name: Free AI Domain Generator
summary.one_liner: A web tool that uses AI models to generate brandable domain names from a startup idea, checks their availability, and compares registration prices across registrars.
use_cases: Brainstorming brandable names for a startup
Finding a domain name that is actually available to register
Comparing registration prices for a new domain
Filtering out taken domains from name ideas
Picking a cheap registrar for a new project
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool where you type a project idea (up to 300 characters) and AI models generate brandable domain name suggestions. It checks live registrar data to visually filter out taken domains, so only available names are shown. It also aggregates registration prices from providers named on the page (Namecheap, Porkbun, Dynadot) to compare deals. The page says the service is free, with no logins or paywalls.
notable: Live availability check against registrar data to hide taken domains
Price comparison across Namecheap, Porkbun, and Dynadot
caveats: Page does not state which AI models are used or how availability and prices are sourced beyond 'live registrar data'
Page does not list supported top-level domains or the number of suggestions generated
